capabilities: Insert an avatar code block into notes
Display an image with a Markdown description beside it
Pick images from the vault or paste image URLs
Configure side, size and image position via YAML options
disambiguation: Not a contact-card or profile manager; it only renders an image-plus-text component inside a note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render a small image with a caption or description inline in a note.
summary: Code-block component that displays a small avatar image with accompanying Markdown text in a note.
